source: AUTONOMOUS_RESEARCH_ORCHESTRATION.md Mission and completion contract items 1 through 6
completion_policy: Every required item must independently PASS with current artifact evidence. Missing, stale, unsupported or blocked evidence is not completion. Engineering fixtures cannot establish scientific requirements.

requirements.description: Clean checkout installs with documented dependencies
Documented fixture tests pass in an independently reproduced clean environment
Registered source inventory verifies; nonredistributable data have documented reacquisition/import paths
Credential/raw-data exclusions and fail-closed inference configuration are independently checked
Frozen real race sample, official candidates, geography and historical crosswalks are verified
Genuine historical statistical baselines evaluated under frozen sample and input rules
Comparable agent variants use same races/outcomes/cutoffs and matched simpler controls
Sealed holdout evaluation, real result tables and retrospective contamination analysis
Frozen hypotheses, questionnaire mapping, estimand, exclusions, variance and sensitivity plan independently accepted
ACS/ANES joint fitting is validated for the stated universe, with support and holdout diagnostics
Permitted real-text stimuli have exact frozen content, rights, timestamps and matched treatments
Randomization, isolation, scoring and invalid response logging independently pass offline integration
Registered real-model evaluation and prespecified sensitivity/uncertainty analysis completed
OpenRouter-only calls enforce atomic reservations, provider reconciliation, cancellation/retry and checkpoint semantics
Owner-approved positive budget, rotated/verified credentials and fresh provider price evidence precede real calls
A nonimplementing auditor has current evidence for every required milestone
Remote CI passes for the reviewed code; local tests alone are not substituted
Every research table/figure and dashboard view is generated from identified validated run artifacts
Reproducibility pack restores environment, configs, manifests and permitted outputs with verified hashes
Technical manuscript draft reflects actual findings and clearly separates proposed/unrun analyses
Public-facing blog draft states supported findings, limitations and review-only status
Complete limitations/failure/source-reuse report is consistent with actual evidence
Accurate requirement-level completion dashboard and current status report exist

publication_boundary: Drafts are for owner review. No external publication, affiliation claim, deployment or political activity is authorized.
